title: Theme list shows near-duplicate and 0-point themes with mixed capitalisation
what_happens: 'not a holiday park' (2 points) and 'Not a holiday park' (1 point) both appear; 'those who really live here' (2) and 'Who really lives here' (0); 'Rentals pay their share' has 0 points. Some titles start lowercase, some uppercase. The heading counts all 8.
who_hurts: An admin reading results can't tell which theme to trust and over-counts what came out of the session.
suggested_fix: Dim 0-point themes or fold them under a 'N empty themes' line, and show titles with a capitalised first letter. Merging the duplicates is a clustering issue, out of this screen.
owners_call: Should 0-point themes show on Overview at all?
